Description
Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate is an independent boarding and day school for girls and boys from 3 months to 19 years old, located near York in the North of England. The school is set in substantial grounds and feature an impressive range of facilities including go carting track, BMX track, football pitches, tennis courts, and swimming pools. Even laser tag!
Queen Ethelburga's College was ranked 10th by the Daily Telegraph, for A*/A A-Level Results, in their 2015 UK Independent School League Tables.
